note: Buyer decision map (Granola AEO method, adopted 2026-11-24). One entry per decision a buyer makes before hiring an executive LinkedIn ghostwriter. Each decision has a Google keyword (measured in Search Console) and AI prompts (measured in answer engines). `prompts` holds every phrasing we track; the first is canonical, the rest are aliases so older citation exports still match. `pages` lists the rallyup page(s) that should win the decision. Replaces the separate 'Tracking prompts' list in backlog.md and data/aeo-outreach/prompts.json (rallyupcontext) as the source of truth. Edit here, then let `aeo/diagnose.py` use it.

stages.1-why: Should our executive do LinkedIn at all, and will it make money?
stages.2-how: Which way: agency, freelancer, in-house, AI tool? Which exec, which platform?
stages.3-shortlist: Who are the providers worth considering?
stages.4-evaluate: Price, guarantee, timeline, proof, risk: is this provider safe to pick?
stages.5-contest: Named alternatives and our own brand
